paragraphs.text: Active exploitation of highly critical vulnerabilities in Drupal core, Mitel MiCollab, and GeoServer has been confirmed, with CISA adding ten flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. These developments demand immediate asset identification and patching across widely deployed content management, collaboration, and geospatial platforms. Vulnerability and asset owners must verify affected versions are inventoried and remediated to maintain control assurance.

Simultaneously, a sophisticated phishing campaign impersonating major brands steals corporate Google and Okta credentials, while North Korean actors poison thousands of GitHub repositories and a password manager suffers a backend breach via GitHub compromise. These identity and supply chain attacks bypass traditional controls and concentrate risk in trusted dependencies. Identity and access owners should review authentication coverage, and supplier risk owners must assess third-party assurance evidence.
